title: Isolating DNA from Wolbachia and Drosophila with the QIAwave DNA Blood and Tissue Kit
author: Helene Hartman
materials: Centrifuge tubes, 1.5 mL, safe-lock, PCR clean
QIAwave DNA Blood and Tissue Kit

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample in a 1.5 mL safe-lock, PCR clean Eppendorf centrifuge tube (Catalog #22363212) using a bead-mill homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Set homogenizer to 1500 rpm
Process at Room temperature for 00:02:00

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a lysis mixture per sample in a 1.5 mL safe-lock, PCR clean Eppendorf centrifuge tube (Catalog #22363212).

substeps.instruction: Combine 180 µL Buffer ATL and 20 µL Proteinase K

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add the lysis mixture to the sample and incubate to digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the prepared lysis mixture to each sample
Vortex briefly to mix
Incubate at 56 °C for a minimum of 02:00:00 in a dry-bath incubator (overnight incubation is also acceptable)
Optional: If using a Thermomixer, set to 56 °C and shake at 300 rpm

steps.title: Prepare Spin Columns and Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: While waiting for the lysis incubation, prepare the columns and the AL/ethanol mixture.

substeps.instruction: Set up 1 set of spin columns and transfer them to clean 1.5 mL safe-lock, PCR clean Eppendorf centrifuge tubes (Catalog #22363212)
Premix 200 µL Buffer AL and 200 µL 200 proof ethanol per sample (prepare extra)

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the spin column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of the Buffer AL/ethanol mixture to each sample
Immediately vortex for 00:00:10 to mix
Transfer samples to spin columns placed within waste collection tubes
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 16000 rcf at Room temperature
Empty collection tubes into a waste container

steps.title: Wash Membranes
steps.instruction: Perform two wash steps to purify the DNA on the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to each sample
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 16000 rcf at Room temperature
Empty collection tubes into a waste container
Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to each sample
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 16000 rcf at Room temperature

steps.title: Dry Membranes
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the columns.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the columns to new collection tubes
Centrifuge for 00:03:00 at 16000 rcf at Room temperature

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL buffer AE directly to the membrane of each column
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:01:00
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 16000 rcf at Room temperature
Note: Position the centrifuge tube lid inward toward the center of the centrifuge to ensure closure

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted DNA based on the intended timeframe of use.

substeps.instruction: Store at -80 °C for long-term storage
Store at -20 °C for use within a few weeks
Store at 4 °C for use within a few days
